name: quandora-staging
description: Staging Quandora plugin with Factor and Strategy creation, analysis, and Paper Trading skills.

interface.shortDescription: Use staging Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora Staging packages Factor Mining, Factor Analysis, Strategy Building, Strategy Analysis, and Paper Trading. Analysis reads owner-scoped server-persisted evidence, diagnoses Factor Health, ratings, charts, and performance, and proposes controlled experiments without automatic mutation.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Staging Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Staging Strategy to combine existing factors into a cross-sectional strategy.
Use Quandora Staging Paper Trading to select an eligible source run and start a simulated run after confirmation.
